title: Maximum height.
officialText:
Membrane structures shall not exceed one story nor shall such structures exceed the height limitations in
feet set forth in Table 503. Membrane structures may be erected above the roof of a building provided that such roof is of
noncombustible construction required to have a fire-resistance rating.
Exception: Noncombustible membrane structures serving as roofs only.
